correctness.rationale: Lyapunov bisects the finitely many signed vector measures of a diffuse input, yielding an exact kernel sign and an order lower bound. Atomic compression of an arbitrary positive finite-rank contraction has a nonnegative diagonal with sum equal to a finite-rank trace at most its rank. The mass-rearrangement bound then matches the top-atom coordinate projection for every rank and every nonnegative L1 input. Exact finite-matrix tests (3,200) corroborate only the atomic calculation, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The finite-rank budget is a natural resource parameter of the SPAP problem. The claim gives a sharp all-rank optimization over the entire positive contraction class, with a genuine nonatomic floor and sorted atomic residuals for arbitrary mixed infinite measures. The two components are proved structurally by Lyapunov and finite-rank trace rather than by recomputing a known table; coordinate projections attain every value.
